instructions.question: What emotional attitude does the poster of this Bosnian tweet convey: positive, neutral or negative?
instructions.rule: Neutral is for odd one-off incidents, curious questions, lyrics, sports fixtures, science or weather items, schedules and plain shop ads. Friendly replies that joke along, agree or tease with :) or :D are positive, and so are uplifting maxims and news of agreements, support, institutional progress or festive events. Wry reports of one's own lasting bad state (tired, sleepless, ugly, unprepared, fed up) are negative. So are sarcasm or contempt toward people, bitter maxims, and news about death, weapons, scandal or disputes. When the tone is truly flat, choose neutral.

neutral.what: No clear feeling: odd one-off incidents, curious or puzzled questions, lyrics, check-ins, schedules, shop ads, sports fixtures, science or weather items.
examples: Ne mogu više ovih čajeva,bešika će da mi eksplodira. (Can't take more teas, my bladder will explode.)
15 minuta trazim fen koji mi se nalazi ispod stola (15 minutes looking for the hairdryer that was under the table)
Hrvatska protiv Brazila otvara Mundijal (Croatia vs Brazil opens the World Cup)
Bazar će biti održan 30. novembra u Katoličkom školskom centru u Sarajevu (The bazaar will be held on 30 November...)
neutral.cues: ?, zašto (why), ko normalan (who in their right mind), I'm at, pogledajte ponudu (see the offer), večeras u (tonight at), mp3
neutral.not_for: Friendly replies with smileys are positive. Lasting personal misery or mockery of people is negative.

positive.what: Warmth, affection, flirting, enjoyment, friendly joking or agreement in replies, praise, uplifting maxims, or news about agreements, support, progress, culture and festive events.
examples: @rooster_62 hahaha tako je! Nema predaje. (hahaha that's right! No surrender.)
@Galina9Taisia ponesi grickalica i naleti :P (bring snacks and drop by)
Cijeni one koji te vole. Pomozi onima koji te trebaju. (Appreciate those who love you. Help those who need you.)
ZAMJENIK VISOKOG PREDSTAVNIKA: SAD ŽELI BIH U NATO-U (US wants BiH in NATO)
positive.cues: volim (I love), uživanje (enjoyment), gotivim (I like), tako je (that's right), dobro jutro (good morning), nedostajala (missed you), :), :D, <3, dogovor (agreement), oslobodio (released), podrška (support)
positive.not_for: Bare sports fixtures, science stories and shop ads are neutral. Laughing at someone's harm or with an insult is negative.

negative.what: Sadness, heartbreak, lasting tiredness or self-criticism, anger, sarcasm or contempt toward people, disgust, bitter maxims, or news about death, weapons, scandal, crime or disputes.
examples: neprospavane noci ++ (sleepless nights)
Zakljucak: ja podocnjake imam uvijek. (Conclusion: I always have dark circles.)
Da mi se pojasni dječurlija po fejsovima (Someone explain the kids on Facebook to me)
Tema: Pet decenija nakon ubistva JFK-a (Five decades after JFK's assassination)
negative.cues: jebem (f***), mrzim (I hate), fuj (yuck), glupan (idiot), povraćaću (I'll vomit), srce puca (heart breaks), boli (hurts), umrla (died), ubistvo (murder), -_-, :(
negative.not_for: Curious questions and funny one-off mishaps are neutral. Affectionate teasing with smileys is positive.
